name: A Patch of Earth
intro: Out east past the stables are Barleybrook Fields - open, level ground. Set your scarecrow anywhere the soil is flat and free, and get those seeds in the ground. They'll grow whether you watch them or not.

steps.text: Place your scarecrow on open, level ground (Barleybrook Fields is ideal)

outro: Now they grow. Sunroot's quick; barley takes its time. Water them if you like - it hurries them along - and pray for rain.
